نكترث (form VIII)
# نَكْتَرِثُ (naktariṯu) /nak.ta.ri.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَرَثَ (iktaraṯa)
# نَكْتَرِثَ (naktariṯa) /nak.ta.ri.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَرَثَ (iktaraṯa)
# نَكْتَرِثْ (naktariṯ) /nak.ta.riθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِكْتَرَثَ (iktaraṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
